truth_boundary: This matrix describes the verified release product surface. Foundation-only or partial systems are explicitly excluded from user-facing release claims instead of being promoted by documentation.

rows.runtime_target: sendMessage -> provider/model execution path
rows.permission_boundary: No elevated authority; tool and remote side effects remain separately gated.
rows.persistence_behavior: Accepted room history persists through canonical room persistence.

rows.runtime_target: room create, switch, delete and save paths
rows.permission_boundary: Destructive room removal remains user-triggered and generation state is guarded.
rows.persistence_behavior: Room state uses the existing durable persistence path with guarded fallback/migration behavior.

rows.surface: Composer, assistant retry flow and specialist task controls
rows.runtime_target: stopGeneration, regeneration/continuation path and execution bridge
rows.permission_boundary: Cancellation never grants authority and never implies an external side effect was reversed.
rows.persistence_behavior: Transient generation state is not promoted to durable success.

rows.runtime_target: free model catalog, selection and model-dependent control refresh
rows.permission_boundary: Selection cannot promote an unproven paid or unknown model into verified-free eligibility.
rows.persistence_behavior: The user's selected model preference persists through existing settings storage.

rows.surface: Settings > Free Model Routing / fallback / provider controls
rows.runtime_target: eligible free-model routing plus health/fallback control
rows.permission_boundary: Free-proof and explicit-provider eligibility remain authoritative.
rows.persistence_behavior: Routing/provider preferences persist; transient provider health remains bounded runtime state.

rows.surface: Settings model list, reasoning/output controls and Free Model Fabric status
rows.trigger: Open settings or change selected model
rows.runtime_target: model catalog -> model limits/capability-aware UI refresh
rows.permission_boundary: Provider/model metadata is descriptive and cannot create action authority.
rows.persistence_behavior: Capability profile is recomputed from the current catalog while user preferences persist separately.

rows.runtime_target: SevenControl adaptive budget + SevenPerformance resource governor
rows.permission_boundary: Degradation may reduce optional depth but cannot weaken permission, safety or verification floors.
rows.persistence_behavior: Compute/tier pressure is transient and does not create a durable quality claim.

rows.runtime_target: reasoning-aware request path
rows.permission_boundary: Reasoning depth does not alter tool permission authority.
rows.persistence_behavior: Existing user preference behavior remains authoritative.

rows.runtime_target: search/retrieval runtime with evidence lineage
rows.permission_boundary: Search output remains evidence/discovery input, not action authority.
rows.persistence_behavior: Accepted answer/evidence may persist in the room while transient fetch progress does not.

rows.surface: Composer attachment control + room knowledge controls
rows.runtime_target: knowledge extraction/rebuild + lazy local PDF runtime
rows.permission_boundary: Only user-selected local files are consumed and extracted text never gains authority over source bytes.
rows.persistence_behavior: Derived room knowledge follows room persistence boundaries; original bytes are not falsely claimed as durable storage.

rows.surface: Chat context behavior + pinned note/knowledge controls
rows.trigger: Message execution and explicit room knowledge changes
rows.runtime_target: Memory/Context control runtime and bridge
rows.permission_boundary: Recall/context placement cannot create permissions or increase source authority.
rows.persistence_behavior: Authoritative room/settings state persists while derived context remains reconstructable.

rows.runtime_target: Coding workspace + runtime coding map + real chat execution
rows.permission_boundary: Verified read/inspect/context paths are exposed; unsupported shell/device writes remain bounded rather than simulated.
rows.persistence_behavior: Attached project context becomes room knowledge only through the verified persistence path.

rows.runtime_target: Research workspace + Research/Epistemic runtime
rows.permission_boundary: Evidence/freshness/conflict status cannot be promoted into user authority.
rows.persistence_behavior: Accepted research output may persist in conversation while transient fetch progress does not.

rows.runtime_target: RPG workspace + world/canon/story/title runtimes
rows.permission_boundary: Model prose proposes; verified world/canon controllers own committed state.
rows.persistence_behavior: World/canon/session state follows canonical runtime persistence boundaries.

rows.surface: Typed result surfaces requested by specialist/runtime flows
rows.runtime_target: schema-bound generated UI renderer
rows.permission_boundary: Generated content is schema-bound and cannot inject arbitrary executable HTML.
rows.persistence_behavior: Rendered view is derived; authoritative source data remains separate.

rows.runtime_target: Vision Fabric foundation only
rows.permission_boundary: Pixels/OCR/VLM observations remain derived evidence and cannot grant authority.
rows.persistence_behavior: NOT_APPLICABLE
rows.rationale: Vision Fabric foundation is verified, but live OCR/VLM acquisition remains partial. Seven must not expose or market a dead image-input control in this release state.

rows.surface: Contextual tool activity inside task/workspace flows
rows.trigger: Planner/runtime selects an eligible tool capability
rows.runtime_target: Tool registry/capability graph plus validated execution bridge
rows.permission_boundary: Tool Security Kernel and exact argument/scope grants remain mandatory.
rows.persistence_behavior: Tool/effect evidence remains ledger or run bound where applicable.

rows.surface: Task/tool permission, error and verification states
rows.trigger: Effectful tool request or uncertain result
rows.runtime_target: Tool security/effect state through control and execution runtimes
rows.permission_boundary: The original user grant is authoritative; tool/model echoes cannot escalate it.
rows.persistence_behavior: Effect/checkpoint evidence preserves dispatch/effect uncertainty where applicable.

rows.runtime_target: Epistemic state, evidence lineage and freshness rules
rows.permission_boundary: Derived data cannot gain authority by repetition, summarization or model corroboration alone.
rows.persistence_behavior: Stored derived evidence retains its lineage boundary.

rows.runtime_target: verification receipts and commit gate
rows.permission_boundary: Missing evidence cannot become PASS.
rows.persistence_behavior: Verification evidence is run/artifact bound.

rows.surface: Coding workspace exposes a bounded verified project-context subset, not the planned full persistent Projects product
rows.runtime_target: Project/File foundation
rows.permission_boundary: Protected paths and user-authorized file scope remain authoritative.
rows.persistence_behavior: The full persistent Projects product is not claimed in this release candidate.
rows.rationale: The full persistent Projects product remains partial; only the verified Coding workspace/file-context subset is release-relevant.

rows.surface: Settings import/export plus automatic room persistence
rows.trigger: backup import/export or automatic room save
rows.runtime_target: canonical backup payload + guarded durable room state
rows.permission_boundary: Imported state is validated before apply and secrets remain outside room-backup authority.
rows.persistence_behavior: Durable room/settings state uses the existing guarded persistence path.

rows.runtime_target: provider streaming path + guarded cancellation/execution state
rows.permission_boundary: Cancellation cannot claim a remote side effect was undone without verification.
rows.persistence_behavior: Only accepted conversation result is committed as completed output.

rows.runtime_target: theme state + frozen Seven identity assets
rows.permission_boundary: Presentation only; no authority effect.
rows.persistence_behavior: Theme preference persists through the existing preference path.

rows.trigger: Locale/direction, reduced-motion preference and keyboard/focus use
rows.runtime_target: Accessibility/RTL/Motion contracts
rows.permission_boundary: Presentation preferences never alter correctness or authority.
rows.persistence_behavior: User/system presentation preferences are respected across reload where applicable.

rows.surface: Android native operations when invoked by an eligible user flow
rows.runtime_target: Android platform bridge, scoped storage/document access and secure native boundary
rows.permission_boundary: Platform authorization and scoped content access are mandatory; no broad filesystem authority is implied.
rows.persistence_behavior: Persisted native grants/secure material follow platform rules.

rows.surface: Whole product with tier-aware compute/visual degradation
rows.runtime_target: SevenPerformance
rows.permission_boundary: Performance downgrades cannot disable safety, permission or verification invariants.
rows.persistence_behavior: Pressure state is transient and preferences remain separate.

rows.runtime_target: Partial observability counters/modules
rows.permission_boundary: Private reasoning and unredacted sensitive data are not exposed.
rows.persistence_behavior: Partial diagnostic infrastructure only.
rows.rationale: Full observability is explicitly partial and is not advertised as a release user feature.

rows.runtime_target: Evolution promotion safety pipeline
rows.permission_boundary: Candidate changes cannot self-promote without evaluation/promotion gates.
rows.persistence_behavior: Artifact/evaluation bound engineering state.
rows.rationale: Self-evolution promotion remains engineering infrastructure, not an end-user control in this release.
